description: Calibration image set for the read-only vision reviewers. Before a live review is trusted, the configured vision model must correctly classify every calibration image: known-bad images must be flagged as findings/errors, current-bad images must be flagged, and reviewed-good images must not be flagged above info. Calibration binds the exact model, prompt hash, and schema hash, so a drift in any of them invalidates the calibration and blocks live review.

images.note: A blank/uniform image must never be passed as acceptable visual content.
A clipped or truncated layout must be flagged.
The current known regression image (materially incorrect rendering) must be flagged.
A human-reviewed good reference image must not be flagged above info severity.
